annotations.title: Archive or reopen an inbox item

description: Archive a handled comment or review in the Unified Inbox (or reopen it with archived: false) so open items stay focused on what still needs a reply. Does not delete anything on the social network. Part of Studio and Pro.

archived.description: true (default) to archive the item; false to reopen it.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

id.description: The inbox item id from inbox_list.
